decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (321 VicarageFarmRoad, 3, 4 and 5 of 6  received 8 March 2011 and 1 and 2  received 6/2/09) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The access doorway to the takeaway shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times: 10am-11pm from Sunday to Wednesday and from 10am-12pm on Thursdays, Fridays and Saturdays.
Condition : 5 - No amplified or other music shall be played in the premises outside the following times 10am to 10pm on any day.
Condition : 6 - The use hereby permitted for a takeaway (A5 use) shall not begin until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound between the takeaway and the residential flats above, has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The measures so approved shall be implemented prior to the use commencing and shall be permanently retained thereafter.
Condition : 7 - The use shall not commence until a secure storage area within the site either within an existing building or one that has the benefit of planning permission, or enclosed by a 2-metre high close boarded fence with gates, which are to be kept shut at all times except when access is required, to house not less than two 1100 litre galvanised steel Eurobins has been identified and made available, together with facilities for the separation and safe storage of glass, metal, plastics, cardboard, food waste and other recyclable materials which shall then be collected and taken to a suitable facility for recycling.  The storage area and bins shall be made permanently available before the development is first occupied and no waste shall be stored outside the site or other than in the designated area.  The lids of the Eurobins shall be fixed shut at all times other than when waste is being emptied into them.  Non-recyclable and perishable waste shall be removed from site no less frequently than once a week.  Waste shall be removed as soon as the bins become full if this is earlier than the time of the normal weekly collection, unless additional covered and enclosed bins (as described above) have been provided and are thereafter made permanently available for the on-site storage of refuse and waste.
Condition : 8 - The kitchen extract system shown on the approved drawings shall be implemented in accordance with approved details, before the use hereby approved as a takeaway (A5) is commenced and shall comply with the following specifications. The system shall be designed so that the maximum operation shall not result in noise that is more than 10dB(A) below background noise levels for the site. The kitchen extract system shall include the following details 
a)	A three-stage filtration system, including grease filters, pre-carbon filters and carbon filters, to be located inside the building.
b)	The point of discharge shall be a minimum of one metre above eaves level or one metre above openable windows of nearby properties.
c)	The ducting shall be circular.
d)	The ventilation duct shall terminate pointing directly upwards and shall not be fitted with a cowl.
e)	The fan shall be isolated from the inlet and discharge ducts using flexible couplings.
f)	The fan shall be mounted using anti-vibration mounts.
g)	The duct shall be isolated from the structure of the building using anti-vibration mouldings and suitable packing material where it passes through solid structures.
description: To extend the hours of operation from 10am - 11pm to 10am-12pm on Thursdays, Fridays and Saturdays
